decisions.what: Used the school identity 'Mwangaza Academy', Milimani Road, P.O. Box 1234 - 20100, Nakuru, with phone +254 712 345 678 and email info@mwangazaacademy.ac.ke
decisions.why: The spec asks for real school details but does not give any; a culturally appropriate Kenyan identity replaces every 'School Name' and [placeholder] token consistently

decisions.what: Restructured programmes into three cards: Pre-Primary (PP1-PP2), Primary (Class 1-8), Secondary (Form 1-4), dropped the Junior School card, and changed the programs grid from 4 to 3 columns at 1024px
decisions.why: The spec lists exactly these three grade levels; 3 cards in a 4-column grid would leave an empty column

decisions.what: Google Maps iframe uses https://www.google.com/maps?q=...&output=embed instead of a /maps/embed?pb=... URL, with a title attribute for accessibility
decisions.why: A valid pb parameter cannot be produced without the Maps UI; the q/output=embed form works without an API key and keeps every attribute the spec requires

decisions.what: Achievement badges are emoji spans with aria-hidden inside the card headings, alongside filled-in stats and testimonials
decisions.why: The spec asks for icons or badges; emoji need no extra assets and are hidden from screen readers

decisions.what: Operating hours are now a <table> with row/column headers (Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM; weekends/holidays closed)
decisions.why: The spec asks for a table; scoped headers keep it accessible
The 'Get in Touch' CTA is a mailto link styled as .btn-primary; without the exclusion the attribute selector (higher specificity) would override the button styling

decisions.what: Added small layout rules (.section-cta, .about-history, paragraph spacing in about cards and history) and removed the unused .map-frame/.map-placeholder styles
decisions.why: The new markup needs spacing because the CSS reset removes margins; the placeholder map markup no longer exists
Spec requires Schema.org structured data with contact info
